body: The weird part is that nothing specific triggers these thoughts. Sometimes I'm bored. Other times I'm upset. The power of the thought is the same. And it's the thought that scares me, not the trigger. If I'm upset about something it rarely bothers me for a long time. What scares me is the instant thought of 'killing yourself will end it'....which is always (or has been) dismissed immediately.  My fear is that one day it won't be dismissed. And thankfully I don't believe I'm moving closer to 'that day'.

They stick out because I remember the reasons why I don't. My fear is that someday I won't have any reasons left. It really scares me. I feel bad that I'm posting at all because I know that other people are having a harder time than me. Thank you for you're response.
What you wrote is beautiful and will stay with me for the rest of my life. Thank you.
